Description: A fragmentary Cave 4 copy of Judges, published by Trebolle Barrera in DJD XIV, preserving parts of the closing chapters of Judges: the Levite and his concubine episode (Judges 19) and the aftermath of the war against Benjamin (Judges 21). It is the second Cave 4 Judges copy, distinct from 4Q49.
Significance: One of only three cataloged Qumran copies of Judges (with 1Q6 and 4Q49). Its Judges 21 ending is a very early witness to the book's closing chapters.
